hens_rule_text: Up to 2 chickens with no permit; 3 to 20 chickens on a lot of 1 acre or less with a fowl permit, plus 20 more per additional acre
permit_notes: A pigeons, small animal and fowl permit from Lincoln-Lancaster County Health Department Animal Control is required once you keep 3 or more chickens; 1 or 2 need no permit. Permits are annual and not transferable.
setback_notes: Pens, enclosures and shelters must be at least 50 feet from a neighboring residence and at least 5 feet from a neighboring property line.
coop_rules: Exercise/shelter area of at least 3 sq ft per chicken; pens kept clean with manure removed at least every 7 days; hard-surface floor if the lot is under 7,500 sq ft.
zoning_notes: Rules sit in the animal control chapter (Title 6) and apply citywide; farmsteads of 20+ acres are exempt.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
research_notes: Read the text of LMC 6.04.040 (table), 6.04.041 and 6.04.050 directly from the enCodePlus e-reader copy of the code. Slaughter is not addressed in the sections read.
